queries_run: Eaton electrical equipment substitute technology threat 2026
electrical equipment industry alternative technology disruption solid state transformer 2026 2027
Eaton Resilient Power Systems acquisition solid-state transformer date

findings.claim: Solid-state transformers (SST) are emerging as a substitute technology for traditional oil-filled/magnetic transformers, offering bidirectional power flow, real-time voltage regulation and compact footprint that conventional units cannot match; utilities, data center owners, rail operators and EV charging providers are driving adoption. The global SST market is projected to grow from roughly $170-205M in 2026 toward $360-380M by 2031-2033 (CAGR ~13%).
findings.source: Mordor Intelligence / MarketsandMarkets / Coherent Market Insights solid-state transformer market reports

findings.claim: Delta Electronics deployed its solid-state transformer system (using SiC high-frequency power conversion) at a hyperscale data center campus in North China in February 2026, in partnership with Chindata Group and Meituan, targeting the same AI-data-center power delivery use case Eaton competes for.
findings.source: Solid-State Transformer Market industry report coverage (researchdive/Cervicorn Insights aggregation)

findings.claim: Eaton completed the acquisition of Resilient Power Systems Inc. on 2025-08-06 (announced July 2025, ~$86M: $55M cash + $31M estimated contingent consideration) to bring medium-voltage solid-state transformer technology in-house, directly addressing the SST substitution threat rather than being displaced by it.
findings.source: Eaton press release "Eaton completes acquisition of Resilient Power Systems Inc., strengthening power distribution offerings"

findings.claim: Eaton guided to first orders for its own solid-state transformer systems in H2 2026, with shipments starting late 2027; analysis frames Eaton's strategy as trying to become a "grid-to-chip" integration platform for AI infrastructure (via Boyd Thermal, an 800V DC pilot programme, an NVIDIA Vera Rubin/Beam partnership, and a Siemens Energy tie-up) rather than remaining a component-only electrical equipment incumbent, in response to Schneider Electric's downstream integration advantage.
findings.source: electroneconomics.substack.com, "Eaton is trying to become Schneider before the AI factory standardises" (citing Eaton 8-K exhibits)

substitute_technology.note: 核心風險是既有油浸式/傳統變壓器產品線可能被固態變壓器取代；但 Eaton 已透過 2025-08 收購 Resilient Power Systems 自建 SST 能力並guide H2 2026 接單，屬主動因應而非被動暴露；Delta 等競爭者已有 SST 落地案場，代表賽道確實在動，非純假設性威脅。

queries_run: Eaton distribution channel disruption OR shift 2026
Eaton business model transition subscription OR platform digital services 2026
Eaton Mobility spin-off split-off exchange offer completion date 2026

findings.claim: On 2026-06-10 Eaton entered into definitive agreements with Dana Incorporated to separate its Mobility Group business and combine it with Dana in a Reverse Morris Trust transaction; Eaton will distribute the Mobility business to its own shareholders via an exchange offer (split-off) in which Eaton shareholders can tender Eaton shares for shares of Mobility (USA) Corporation, with the transaction expected to close by end of Q1 2027 subject to regulatory approval and Form 10 effectiveness. This restructures Eaton's channel/customer relationships in the Mobility (vehicle/off-highway) business rather than affecting its core Electrical segment go-to-market.
findings.source: Eaton press release "Eaton Advances 2030 Growth Strategy with Announcement to Combine Mobility Group with Dana Incorporated"; Dana Incorporated press release

findings.claim: Eaton is shifting part of its software business model toward recurring revenue via flexible/usage-based software monetization (moving away from a mix of free-with-hardware and one-time-entitlement licensing toward SaaS-style models), implemented with Revenera's Software Monetization platform (Entitlement Management and Software Licensing) to centralize licensing across divisions.
findings.source: Revenera case study "Eaton Growing Recurring Revenue Through Flexible Software Monetization Models"

findings.claim: Eaton's Brightlayer digital platform (including the Brightlayer Data Centers suite launched 2023) provides a software/data layer on top of connectable electrical hardware assets for data center operators, positioning Eaton toward a platform/software-attach go-to-market rather than pure hardware sales; this is an incremental layer on top of the existing distributor channel, not a replacement of it.
findings.source: Eaton press release "Eaton delivers industry-first software platform to help data center operators accelerate their digital transformation journey"; eaton.com/digital

channel_business_model_shift.note: 查無證據顯示 Eaton 核心電氣設備業務的傳統經銷商通路正被結構性瓦解或走向 D2C；查到的通路面變動是 Mobility 分割業務的 Reverse Morris Trust 交易（不影響 Electrical 核心通路），商業模式面則是軟體訂閱化（Brightlayer/Revenera）疊加在既有硬體通路之上，屬漸進式加值而非通路轉移。
